title: Vault-Backed Secret Materialization Foundation
goal: Move protected access handling from baseline local secret storage toward a controlled deployment-key or vault-backed pattern.
scope: Design and implement the first vault-backed or deployment-key-backed secret materialization slice for protected wizard credentials and tokens. Preserve existing protected access metadata behavior and never expose raw secret material in UI, reports, MCP, or logs.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Harden protected secret materialization only. Do not add a full enterprise secrets platform or expose secrets through UI/report/API surfaces.
notes: Protected access metadata may remain visible, raw secret material must not.
Existing deterministic run configuration behavior must remain compatible.

success_criteria: A first deployment-key or vault-backed secret materialization path exists or is fully decision-complete for implementation.
Existing access contexts continue to show safe metadata only.
Raw secrets do not appear in UI, reports, logs, MCP output, or test artifacts.
Fallback behavior for missing vault/deployment-key configuration is explicit and safe.
Tests cover secret non-disclosure and backward-compatible protected access metadata.
must_not_touch: pack registry and runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Raw secret material is not exposed through supported surfaces.
Protected metadata remains useful and backward-compatible.
Missing hardening configuration fails safely or falls back to the documented baseline.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The selected secret hardening approach is scoped before implementation starts.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with secret hardening changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new secret handling baseline and remaining deployment risks.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Secret display in reports or UI
